nodes.label: API & Route Protection
nodes.rationale: Protects /api/user/* and /learn/* via Next.js Middleware, limits /api/auth/* to 5 failed attempts/min, and sanitizes static asset paths against Path Traversal.

nodes.label: Password Policy & Hashing
nodes.rationale: Requires bcrypt (>=12 salt rounds) or argon2id, forbids storing raw passwords, and enforces >=8 chars with >=1 number and >=1 uppercase letter.

nodes.label: Next.js Agent Rules
nodes.rationale: This Next.js version has breaking changes where APIs, conventions, and file structure differ from older versions, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code.

nodes.label: Weak Kanji Tracker
nodes.rationale: Automatically upserts incorrectly answered kanji during quizzes into WeakKanji with mistakeCount and lastMistake so learners can review their top 10 struggled kanji on /profile.

nodes.label: Mobile-First & Strict TypeScript Standards
nodes.rationale: Mandates designing layouts for 360px-430px viewports before md:/lg: breakpoints, strict TypeScript without any, modular components, and custom hooks for audio/SVG animations.

nodes.label: Authentication & JWT Session Flow
nodes.rationale: Combines Credentials and Google OAuth 2.0 providers using JWT strategy with HTTP-only cookies, SameSite=Lax, and production Secure flag.

nodes.label: Washi Light/Dark Palette & Furigana Positioning (Phase 7)
nodes.rationale: Replaced default design-system palette with Light [800020, F3E6D5, FFF9F2, D45060] and Dark [092328, 12544F, 2A835F, 8BBB92] and positioned furigana above example words.

nodes.label: Execution Rules (Kasih Role, Paksa Jeda, Kunci Output)
nodes.norm_label: execution rules (kasih role, paksa jeda, kunci output)
nodes.rationale: Enforces executing one task from task.md at a time, stopping to update task.md after completion, avoiding dead code, and using Conventional Commits.

nodes.label: Hybrid DB/JSON Kanji Fetching (Phase 15)
nodes.rationale: Refactors getKanjiByLevel to query PostgreSQL first and fallback to local JSON files if DB is empty.

nodes.label: OAuth Set-Password Gate (Phase 14)
nodes.rationale: Injects hasPassword into JWT/Session and intercepts OAuth users without a password via middleware/proxy to redirect to /auth/set-password, unblocking via password_set cookie.

nodes.label: KanjiVG 5-Digit Hex SVG Convention
nodes.rationale: Standardizes stroke SVG file naming as UTF-8 hex code zero-padded to 5 digits (e.g. 日 -> 065e5.svg) stored under public/svg/kanji/[hex].svg.

nodes.label: Tiered Kanji Curriculum (/learn)
nodes.rationale: Segments JLPT N5-N1 into small Sub-level units of 10 Kanji each to prevent overloading short-term memory (cognitive load).

nodes.label: KanjiPaham Platform
nodes.rationale: Built with a warm Japanese stationery (washi) aesthetic to replace rigid dictionary/rote memorization apps with an interactive, structured, mobile-first learning flow for Indonesian and English learners.

nodes.label: Web Speech API (ja-JP)
nodes.rationale: Chosen for native browser speech synthesis without server latency.

nodes.label: KanjiPaham PRD
nodes.rationale: Defines product scope for a structured, bite-sized, distraction-free mobile study companion for Kana and JLPT N5-N1 Kanji.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Audio Pronunciation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses browser Web Speech API (ja-JP) in Phase 1 (MVP) and plans native MP3s from the Tatoeba project in Phase 2 (Production).

nodes.label: PRD Non-Functional Requirements
nodes.rationale: Requires FCP < 1.2s on 4G mobile, audio playback latency < 150ms, and persistent offline-friendly cache for local JSON Kanji assets.
